title: Encoded Checks Characterize Machine Steps
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x,w,w'$ be Boolean lists, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$. The step-check predicate holds if and only if there are configurations $C,C'$ of $N$ on input $x$ such that $C$ and $C'$ have all work-tape heads and nonblank contents within radius $s$, the code of $C$ is $w$, the code of $C'$ is $w'$, and $C'$ is obtained from $C$ in one step of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
